answer.reason: Different business model: Wendy’s serves made-to-order restaurant meals through drive-thru and delivery and recruits franchise owners. McCormick manufactures and distributes packaged seasonings, condiments and ingredients. Their buyers seek prepared restaurant meals versus products for cooking or food production; broad exposure to food consumers does not establish comparable customers.
